limitations: Single-owner-approved inherited source references, not independent adjudication or a representative holdout.
Only the existing fixed nonnull canonical scope is scored; null boundaries, venue equivalence, extra entities and source conflicts remain explicit review work.
Strict scoped completeness is not title-only detection recall; missing scheduled status remains a failure without inventing it.
Inputs are source-derived JSON/ICS/HTML text, not OCR. Five separately approved actual-media examples are excluded from this diagnostic.
Existing provisional family grouping is preserved without new organizer/alias adjudication.
A schema/evidence validation failure is a failed attempt, never a successful empty result.
Wilson intervals describe binomial arithmetic on scoped units; within-family dependence is not cluster-adjusted, so they do not establish independent-source uncertainty or campus coverage.
